title: CN/V20261019 private fixed deck window to own hand, remainder-only shuffle to bottom
$comment: Sources: CN-advanced-3.1.0 SHA256 27bda43d8cb78ed800891c6793e5efd945ac64d94a83ceff8adaed10e8f67419; I.H p18; II.A p19; II.C-20 p41; II.D-04/D-05 pp43-44; II.D-02 pp42-43; II.E-35/E-36 pp73-74 (one-based PDF). Rika csv4C 122/129 G primary PNG SHA256 f31a2e3e9d0d0f17e82c99d6c0dcf2efc3451cb7df37be9bfbdcf90235ae0ffa, observed 2026-10-20: https://image.pokemon.com.cn/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/1cff28e56de380a7f6930f9609d94bba82ed1d12.png via https://www.pokemon.cn/tcg/product/15488.html . This observation is NOT production approval, a trustpin, an erratum search, or permission to accept old metadata. CardSelector and existing effect-program cardQuantity conventions are reused, with any/all distinguished and all deliberately outside this operation.

quantity.description: CN literal quantities: any-card exact requires min(count, available); hidden specific predicates can select fewer/zero (I.H); any-card upTo normally has minimum one (D-05); any quantity allows zero (D-02). No implicit optional flag, all, or default count.

action.description: Only the actual effect user's deck -> that user's hand. No arbitrary from/to/side. Viewing does not reveal to the opponent. The rest is shuffled face down as its own subset and placed under the uninspected deck, never a full-deck shuffle.

ids.description: Physical instance IDs as used by game-state, NOT definition/printing numbers. Exact strings are preserved.

plan.description: PRIVATE saved plan, never a public or owner's post-shuffle view. Window is top first; selected retains answer order; remainder is the original-order complement, BEFORE shuffling. Cross-array partition/order, live-window and quantity checks require assertDeckInspectionPlan against authoritative pre-escrow context; schema shape alone is not an authenticated save, catalog approval or RNG proof.

shuffledRemainder.description: Host-only exact random permutation in top-first order. Never expose it or RNG state to either player. A nonempty subset, even a singleton, counts as shuffled; empty does not. assertDeckInspectionRemainder checks conservation, not RNG provenance. Main runtime consumes real RNG and applies moves.
